title: Nutty Fluffy Vegan Rice Bowl
description: A flavorful and filling vegan rice bowl with a nutty twist. This dish is perfect for a quick and easy lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: fluffy
ingredients.notes: such as mung beans or tofu

ingredients.name: chinese
ingredients.notes: such as soy sauce or tamari

instructions: Rinse the rice in a fine mesh strainer and drain well.
In a medium saucepan, bring the water to a boil.
Add the rice to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the nutty, fluffy, and chinese ingredients.
Once the rice is cooked, fluff it with a fork and stir in the nutty mixture.
Heat the sesame oil in a small pan over medium heat.
Add the rice mixture to the pan and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
